summary: Decodes game resources natively in worker threads: lanes by free memory, a time budget per decode, idle exit and trimming.

faults.when: A decode took longer than its budget; the worker is terminated and WolvenKit is tried next.
The native reader doesn't read this resource kind.

lifetime: Per route, while decodes are asked for; workers exit after 15 s idle.

x-friction.gap: Lanes follow free memory, workers exit idle and trim; a time-budget kill falls back to WolvenKit.
x-friction.closes: Worker pools sized from free memory, with a declared fallback approach.

x-friction.gap: Falling back to WolvenKit after a native failure is a declared alternative approach, written by hand today.
x-friction.closes: Failures that select a declared fallback.
